context: Yumiko comes alone to ask Dr. Saito about her aging mother's prognosis.
purpose: adult-child consulting doctor about aging parent — careful difficult conversation

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 先生、母の状態、正直に教えてください。
lines.en: Doctor, mother's condition — tell me honestly.
lines.style: Maternal warm soft careful brave-asking direct, the soft real real-care audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、お母さんは、安定しています。でも、ゆっくり進行はしています。
lines.en: Yes, she's stable. But the condition slowly progresses.
lines.style: Doctor warm professional gentle honest-careful balanced, the soft real real-care audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 進行は、どのくらいの早さで？
lines.style: Maternal warm soft brave careful-pushing-real, the soft real real-care audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 個人差はありますが、数年単位で、変化が出てきます。
lines.en: There's variation, but over years, changes appear.
lines.style: Doctor warm professional gentle careful-honest specific-clinical, the soft real real-care audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 私たち家族で、どう支えたらいいでしょうか。
lines.en: How should we, the family, support her?
lines.style: Maternal warm soft sincere caring-asking-practical, the soft real real-care audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 無理させない、ゆっくり見守る、それが一番。
lines.en: Don't push her, watch slowly — that's best.
lines.style: Doctor warm gentle sincere wise-clear adviser-warm, the soft real real-care audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 本当に、ありがとうございます。何か変化あったら、すぐ連絡します。
lines.en: Truly, thank you. If anything changes, I'll contact immediately.
lines.style: Maternal warm sincere deep closing-grateful-committed, the soft real real-care audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.
